EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Instructions - Freshmen/Orientation
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
If you are an incoming freshman and will be attending an orientation, the differences between a Sun Card and MidFirst Pitchfork Card will be explained at orientation. You will choose which card you want at orientation and your card will be issued to you that day. Please be sure to bring a government issued ID with you to orientation. Acceptable forms of ID are: US drivers license, state issued ID card, US passport, or US Visa.
To expedite the process of obtaining a student ID, please visit our Freshman Sun Card page. https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices#first-time-freshmen
Once you have read the photo upload guidelines, click on UPLOAD YOUR PHOTO NOW. https://webapp4.asu.edu/cardservices/ Here you will upload the photo for your ASU ID as well as verification ID. Please allow 1-2 business days for your photo to be approved. Acceptable forms of ID are: US drivers license, state issued ID card, US passport, or US Visa.
For more information on the Pitchfork Card please click here. https://asu.midfirst.com/pitchfork-card
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
